title: Miami Spice Back with New Reserve Tier and 300 Restaurants
summary: The 25th edition of Miami Spice Restaurant Months is back from August 1 through September 30, 2026. This year’s program from The Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau (GMCVB) features three-course prix-fixe menus at a minimum of 30% savings at more than 300 participating…
whatHappening: Miami Spice Restaurant Month is launching its 25th edition, running August 1 through September 30, 2026. The program features three-course prix-fixe menus with minimum 30% savings across more than 300 participating restaurants, now including a new reserve tier.
whoInvolved: The Greater Miami Convention & Visitors Bureau (GMCVB) is organizing the program. The bureau represents Miami's hospitality and tourism industry, promoting the region as a dining and travel destination.
whyMatters: The expanded program drives tourism revenue and customer traffic to Miami restaurants during the slower summer season. The new reserve tier broadens appeal across price points, allowing both budget-conscious and upscale diners to participate in the initiative.
moreContext: Miami Spice has been a cornerstone dining promotion for two and a half decades, establishing itself as one of the country's longest-running restaurant value programs. The 300+ participating restaurants span diverse cuisines and neighborhoods across Greater Miami. The addition of a reserve tier this year suggests the program is evolving to capture higher-end dining experiences alongside traditional prix-fixe offerings. Such programs typically boost restaurant bookings by 20-40% during their run, providing meaningful revenue boosts for participating establishments.
